## 7 Production Systems Deployed

1. **ParkAOT (ParkOS) — Smart Parking & POS Automation**: ASP.NET Core 8 MVC, C#, PostgreSQL 16, SignalR, FastReport, Python ANPR, Device Service Orchestration, <5ms tariff evaluation.
2. **ANPR Multi-Lane Central Monitoring & Plaza Telemetry**: 3-tier distributed monitoring (LPU &rarr; Plaza &rarr; Central), 150+ monitored lanes, real-time WebSocket heartbeats.
3. **Vehicle Re-Identification & Visual Search Engine**: Deep metric learning with OSNet 512-D embeddings and sub-15ms FAISS vector similarity search.
4. **NEXTGEN Consolidated Highway ATMS**: Enterprise Service-Oriented Architecture unifying VMS, ATCC, ECB, weather sensors, and CCTV with Windows Services.
5. **Video Management System (VMS) & Multi-Camera PTZ Engine**: Full ONVIF WS-Discovery, PTZ control, sub-200ms WebRTC (WHEP) streaming via MediaMTX, and synchronized historical playback.
6. **Edge-Based ANPR & Automatic Traffic Classifier (ATCC)**: Raspberry Pi 5 embedded vision with YOLOv8, PaddleOCR (98% accuracy on Indian plates), and live Hugging Face demo.
7. **ATMS Progressive Web App & Mobile Diagnostic Console**: Service Worker offline caching for mobile field technicians, incident dispatching, and device diagnostics.
